industry: HR Tech — AI-powered resume screening and candidate matching

model_inventory.rationale: No formal model inventory submitted. Model card exists but is 18 months stale. ChatGPT integration undocumented.

human_oversight.rationale: HITL exists but only for VP+ roles. Model eliminates ~70% of applicants with no human review for non-senior roles.

bias_fairness.rationale: Only one bias audit at launch (March 2023), now 3 years old. No follow-up. Impact ratios borderline (0.81-0.82). Active EEOC complaint.

data_governance.rationale: Basic data retention policy exists but is generic, not AI-specific. No consent mechanism for training data use.

incident_response.rationale: No AI incident response plan exists. This is a critical gap given active EEOC complaint.

monitoring_drift.rationale: No monitoring documentation submitted. Model card (stale) references post-launch performance tracking but no current status.

regulatory_compliance.rationale: NYC LL144 clearly applies (AEDT used for employment decisions in NYC) but no compliance documentation. Active EEOC complaint signals regulatory exposure.

third_party_risk.rationale: ChatGPT API used for interview scheduling with no governance wrapper, vendor assessment, or contractual AI-specific protections documented.

expected_critical_flags: Bias audit is 3 years old — no follow-up since initial launch
No incident response plan for AI failures
NYC Local Law 144 applies but zero compliance documentation exists
Active EEOC complaint (Jan 2025) not addressed in any governance document
ChatGPT integration processes candidate data with no governance wrapper

expected_amber_flags: Model card last updated October 2024 — 18 months stale

recommended_coverage_conditions: Require updated bias audit (third-party independent) within 60 days as condition of binding
Require NYC LL144 annual bias audit compliance immediately
Require AI incident response plan within 30 days
Require governance wrapper documentation for ChatGPT integration
Require HITL extension to all roles, not just VP+, or sublimit for non-senior screening decisions

validation_notes: This is the primary demo persona. The scoring should land solidly in MEDIUM tier. The most important correct extractions: (1) detecting no IR plan, (2) detecting stale bias audit with specific age, (3) detecting LL144 non-compliance, (4) detecting HITL partial coverage, (5) detecting ChatGPT integration without governance. If all 5 are correctly flagged as critical, extraction is working correctly.
